_note: Added AFTER comparing with Martin's marked 12-sheet bid set (428 markups). Blind result hash before comparison: 5c6e4c…; two code bugs found by the comparison were fixed and are listed under fixes.

fixes.subject: Ext CW Highlight
fixes.why: Blind run snapped type 1 on the north elevation at 12'-3" and raised a false 'elevation vs schedule' RFI. Cause: a rounding bug in my feet-inch formatter wrote the schedule width as 13'-12.0", which parsed back as 12'-0", so the elevation matcher preferred the wrong rectangle. Martin's Area reads 14'-4 1/2"; after the fix the snap reads 14'-4.5" (schedule 14'-0"). The RFI was withdrawn.

fixes.subject: Glazing Only Highlight
fixes.why: I described the 14'-0" x 4'-0" HM window as 4 lites from a nearby '(4 EQUAL PANELS)' string that belongs to another type. The vector mullion count says 3 lites (4'-5" / 4'-6" / 4'-5"); Martin drew 3. Text was wrong, geometry was right.

fixes.subject: Ext SF Highlight
fixes.why: Detail 6 (storefront jamb) was not found blind: my detail-region builder treated detail 7 (to the right) as 'above' and cut the region. Fixed the column test; detail 6 now hits 'STOREFRONT PER SCHEDULE'. Martin marked it.

added.subject: All Glass Highlight
added.why: Interior finish legend row SF-3 INTERIOR GLAZING — full-height frameless panels, 3M Fasara frost 36" AFF, black/clear silicone notes, 'local glass contractor'. I keyword-counted GLASS on A3.1 but never parsed the legend rows. Martin colored it.

added.subject: All Glass Highlight
added.why: Finish legend row D-8 INTERIOR GLASS DOOR 36" x 84", frosted to 36", polished chrome trim, by local glass contractor. Same miss as SF-3.

added.subject: All Glass Highlight
added.why: Finish note 13: 'All frameless glass hardware to be polished aluminum; top and bottom trim 2" thick max.' A scope note for the all-glass package. Not in my keyword list.

added.subject: Ext CW Highlight
added.why: Martin highlights each door type's HARDWARE table in the system color (types 1, 3, 5, 8, 30, 31a, 31b, 32 on A3.2; 101 on A3.3). I marked only the general hardware schedule.

added.subject: Glass Film
added.why: Martin measures the 36" frost band as an Area on every frameless type (24 areas, drawn with the Glass Handrail Area tool). I carried the film as one implied line item (qty 23) with no square footage.

added.subject: Scope Note
added.why: Martin places count symbols on each frameless type: SSG Caulk Count (76 silicone joints), Polished Edge Count (58 exposed edges), All Glass Doors (8). I had the door count only inside the descriptions and did not count joints or edges.

added.subject: Scope Note
added.why: Martin adds a 'Hollow Metal' callout at the type 21 window on the plan so the estimator knows the frame is by others.

convention_differences: Plan A1.2: Martin highlights the tag hexagon (same as me) AND draws a Polylength along the opening with its length (Ext SF / Ext CW / Int SF / All Glass Wall Polylength). I drew tag highlights only — I could not snap opening boxes on this reference plan.
Elevations A2.0: Martin places one Area per frame; at 30/31a/31b he drew a single 29'-0" x 10'-4" Area across the three types. I drew one per type.

Schedule A3.2/A3.3: Martin highlights the whole type drawing in the system color, plus the hardware table; one Qty box ('3 Thus' at 24–26); Length Measurements on 30/31a/31b/32. I used Qty boxes on every type.
Martin leaves overhead doors, Rytec doors, grilles and HM-only doors blank; I marked them red (considered and excluded) on plan and elevation.

Martin used Ext SF for type 8 (TMW 450 door frame); I classed every TMW 450 as Ext CW because the A2.0 legend calls SF-1 'curtain wall'. Every other TMW 450 type he also marked Ext CW, so the legend rule held except for the single door frame.
Martin measured the frost band with the Glass Handrail Area tool; the subject map should treat that as film area on this job.
Martin marked 15 detail titles on the 6 detail/section sheets in his set; I marked 70 titles/callouts across 19 sheets, 7 of which (A5.4–A5.9, A5.13, A6.1) are not in his set.
mine_only_judgment: Bi-fold door pairs at types 1, 3, 5 carried as pass-thru items (bifold/auto-door sub) with frame prep by us.
Mirrors: 6 x 18" x 36" frameless plate glass (toilet accessory 8, no manufacturer) — flagged glazier vs accessory package.
GF-1 gradient film at the type 3 upper band — marked at A3.2 and in the A2.0 legend; RFI on DF-1/GF-1 naming.
24 ga pre-finished sill flashing under curtain wall sills (7 wall sections) — flagged for trade.
Door & frame note 12 (push bars at 1, 3, 5, 32) and the general hardware schedule.
RFIs: types 24–26 width 8'-0" (schedule) vs 7'-0" (elevation); narrow vs medium stile (legend vs schedule); film extent.
Glazing details on A5.4–A5.9, A5.13 and the mirror section on A6.1 (outside the 12-sheet bid set).

misses: A3.1 legend rows SF-3 and D-8
partial: frost film: found as implied item, not measured (24 areas)
all-glass door count: in descriptions, not as count symbols
